notes.title: Fishing Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/9387552aaf3ea97799ef97fa3702de84ebcb1f34.png[/img]

A fishing spot has appeared near Smalltown and it has tons of new fishies. Come and take a break from dungeon crawling and relax on the beach.

The fishing update includes a fishing minigame that lets you catch different types of fishes. These fishes can be used to aid your party or can be sold for gold.

To catch a fish, you will need to press REEL at the right moment and reel the fish in. Once you caught one, you will need to maintain your line and reel the fish in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/2e5185228413cf0f73b6c4b1ffa1000721490a4c.png[/img]

The update also include a few new items to ease up the end game bosses. Be sure to look for them around the fishing spot.

Watch out for EVIL FISHIES!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/5bb963e6e99b4ff3737ddb631bbfa735e476e083.png[/img]

- New fishing area
- New treasures
- New items
- More fish

- fixed keyboard/controller clicking recieving double input on some buttons

notes.title: Crystal Story: The Hero and the Evil Witch now Available!
notes.content:
Hooray! Crystal Story is now available to play! Come and explore the sights of Smalltown. Here is a mini guide to get you started…

[h1]Dungeons[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/bfd5d77331ec572c8b37e186eaec6f7242cd501a.png[/img]
You can move around dungeons using a Mouse, a Keyboard, or a Controller. Choose any control scheme you prefer. Bumping into enemies while inside a dungeon will start battles. You can also collect treasure you find by interacting on it.

[h1]Map[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/11bbe2388f3a1426c9308b7acffc0287d6bbdab2.png[/img]
Explore the areas around Smalltown. New areas unlock as you explore further into Evil Cave. Be sure to check the map from time to time for any new areas!

[h1]Town[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/0dc801f7b2ec09befdcb6cf6d1ca29b294a00803.png[/img]
The Town is where you can rest and take a break from exploring. You can buy or sell items on the Shop or rest at an inn. Alchemy will let you combine certain items to form a new one, while Reforge will create a random item from an existing one.

[h1]Thanks![/h1]
Please let me know what you think on the steam discussions page. Feedback and new ideas are always welcome. Let me know if you want to see a feature in a future update or maybe in a sequel. Please also let me know if you find any bugs!

notes.title: Crystal Story Release Date: 5/29
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Crystal Story: The Hero and the Evil Witch will be out on 5/29 at 10:00 am PST. 

[h1]Trailer[/h1]

[previewyoutube=fOHKqRcyXlY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Adventure![/h1]
Get ready for a turn-based dungeon crawling adventure! Join the gang of Mercenary Inc as they battle through Evil Cave to capture the Evil Witch. Visit Smalltown once again and enjoy the randomly generated sights of "Small Forest", "Water Ruins", or the "Hidden Shrine". Pick up shiny colored loot and be amazed at the numbers written on it. Complete epic quests such as stopping a thief or finding missing cats. All of these and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37615244/3849e0567bd6973dd679c9379978233c90641250.png[/img]

[h1]Thanks![/h1]
Hope to see you next week!
